_comment: Upload metadata for the gods-eye-opensky-proxy Worker (PUT /accounts/<id>/workers/scripts/gods-eye-opensky-proxy, multipart: 'metadata' + 'worker.js'). ALWAYS send every binding below + keep_bindings:['secret_text'] (keeps AISSTREAM_API_KEY, CWA_API_KEY, INGEST_TOKEN, VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY): a PUT replaces the binding list, so leaving one out silently removes it. GET /api/health reports missing bindings and the collector workflow fails on it.
